vietnamese.description: Tìm và xác minh khách hàng tiềm năng theo hồ sơ phù hợp, tín hiệu mua và bằng chứng công khai, kể cả phát biểu trên podcast.
examples: Lập danh sách công ty phù hợp hồ sơ này từ tín hiệu công khai, xác minh ngày phát sóng podcast và người phát biểu; chưa liên hệ ai.

findings: English core plus signal-plays.md distinguish public research from outreach, require dated podcast statements and speaker verification, and include privacy/compliance guidance. No contact lists were queried or messages sent.

19 directly linked tool guides/registry retained at the same source commit under references/upstream. references/upstream/tools/integrations/ploy.md:57 contains a real curl-to-shell installer instruction; retain bytes but quarantine, never execute it during intake.

Optional integrations include paid enrichment, visitor identification, API keys, browser access and external CLI dependencies. Source guides can reference tools/clis not bundled here; these optional integration bundles are not claimed complete or functional.
Firecrawl podcast guide names third-party terms and variable costs; it does not authorize accepting terms or spending. The 90-day podcast window is an upstream heuristic, not a measured guarantee.

notes: English SKILL.md and downloaded source files are byte-identical to the pinned GitHub commit.
No upstream scripts were executed. Compatibility is static only; runtime and provider acceptance remain untested.
